record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace absolute padded-position IDs with observed-prefix position IDs: cumsum(seq != 0), with padding ID zero. This gives the same observed prefix consistent positions during training and inference, potentially improving short-history generalization. Retain maxlen 64, the four-state 0.8/0.2 causal readout, and final-real-position inference. Preserve features, embedding tables, causal backbone, scoring, loss and optimizer; update predictor metadata consistently.

category_rationales.rationale: Assign observed items cumulative prefix positions and padding position zero across all four category models. This tests position alignment between training prefixes and inference histories while retaining maxlen 64, causal convolutions, four-state 0.8/0.2 readout, embedding shapes, scoring, loss and optimizer. Record and validate the position convention in the generated predictor.
